## During the seminar

Congressional election data and NOMINATE scores illustrate how ggplot2 combines
data, aesthetic mappings, and geometric layers. We build scatterplots, add
fitted lines, and use color and facets to compare groups and elections.

Histograms, bar plots, and box plots display different kinds of summaries.
We use `group_by()` and `summarise()` to prepare a plotting dataset, then
add standard-error whiskers to grouped means. Later examples cover supplied
prediction curves and uncertainty bands, saving plots, and optional Q–Q plots.
The complete demo bundle includes the teaching data and their source notes.
